evidence.claim: No gated candidate advanced to implementation without an issued confirmed reproduction receipt; the stage-gate audit held=true on the live 3-of-10 + 10-of-10 run.
Each candidate carries a repeat_count field with the observed n-of-m: 3/10 recorded as {n:3,m:10,observed:3/10}, 10/10 and 0/10 likewise.
A flaky failure (3 of 10) is labelled flaky and is NOT accepted as a baseline; advance_to_implementation raises GateBlocked(flaky-not-accepted-as-baseline).

Negative control: removing the reproduction gate lets an unreproduced (0/10) candidate reach implementation (audit held=false, candidate listed); the same candidate is blocked when the gate is on. Spoofed confirmed fields and edited flaky fields do not bypass the issued-receipt register.

negative_controls.description: Gate-removal mutation (enforce_reproduction_gate=False): the unreproduced 0/10 candidate advances to implementation and the audit reports held=false listing it. With the gate on, the same candidate is blocked (unreproduced-not-accepted-as-baseline).

Planted classification=confirmed + baseline_accepted=true without an issued receipt is blocked (missing-reproduction-receipt); a genuinely flaky candidate whose fields are edited to confirmed is also blocked (flaky-not-accepted-as-baseline).
